links.label: Gavilan College Library home page (OneSearch)
links.use_when: The library's front door and the entry point for OneSearch / the library catalog. Use for a general 'where do I start with the library' pointer.

links.label: Gavilan College website
links.use_when: General Gavilan College information that is NOT a library matter - admissions, registration, counseling, financial aid, programs, the academic calendar.

links.label: Online textbook and e-book collections
links.use_when: The library's online / electronic textbook and e-book collections, for a student who wants to read a textbook online rather than borrow a print copy.

links.label: Subject research guides (LibGuides)
links.use_when: Librarian-built starting points for a subject, course, or assignment. Good for 'how do I start researching X' pointers.

links.label: Gavilan College Bookstore - course materials
links.use_when: Buying or renting a course textbook. The library does not sell textbooks; the bookstore is where students purchase or rent them.

links.label: Gilroy campus map
links.use_when: Finding a building, office, department, or the library itself on the main Gilroy campus.

links.label: Interactive Gilroy campus map
links.use_when: A clickable, interactive version of the Gilroy campus map. Offer alongside the static map.

links.label: Gavilan College Public Safety
links.use_when: Campus safety and security - safety escorts, parking, lost and found, reporting an incident, emergency information.

links.label: Interlibrary Loan (ILL) requests
links.use_when: Requesting a book or article Gavilan does not own, borrowed on the student's behalf from another library. The follow-up when the catalog shows an item is not held.

links.label: Library laptop borrowing
links.use_when: Requesting or borrowing a laptop from the library. This is the catalog record students place the request from.
